mapper.update: UPDATE `users` SET USER_STATUS = 'LOCKED' WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND USER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE `users` SET USER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND USER_STATUS IN ('LOCKED', 'BANNED')
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS userId, LOGIN_ID AS loginId, PASSWORD AS password, USER_ROLE AS userRole, USER_STATUS AS userStatus FROM users WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} FOR UPDATE
